name: nircmd
description: Multi-purpose command-line utility for Windows system administration and automation

tools.description: Comprehensive command-line tool for Windows operations like window management, system control, and registry manipulation
tools.usage:
nircmd win hide title "Calculator" # Hide window by title
nircmd setvolume 0.8 # Set system volume to 80%
nircmd cdrom open # Open CD/DVD tray
nircmd monitor off # Turn off monitor
nircmd exitwin shutdown # Shutdown system

tools.description: Console version of NirCmd with enhanced output and scripting capabilities
tools.usage:
nircmdc win max process "notepad.exe" # Maximize notepad windows
nircmdc setdefaultsounddevice "Speakers" # Set default audio device
nircmdc exec show "C:\Program Files" # Open folder
nircmdc killprocess "process.exe" # Kill process by name
